<!-- pr-reviewer: 5b7cc418e1f9f9fc0f6d3283cf55814c320dc5f0 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (a `feat`, so it merges at the next minor cut)

## What looks good
- The saved-point logic in `History` (`crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs`) is small and correct: undo or redo onto the saved depth is clean, and a new command while the saved depth is on the redo stack makes it unreachable (`None`).
- The dirty flag lives in the app layer and the ui only holds the held action, so ui -> app layering is respected. The prompt answers go through the command queue.
- Only `NewDocument`, `OpenProjectDialog` and `Quit` are guarded. The scripted `*File` paths skip the prompt, so headless runs cannot hang.
- A failed or cancelled save keeps the document open and says why on the status line.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests in the diff. New modules carry a provenance line. The PR does not touch `CHANGELOG.md`, `build.rs`, `.github/`, scripts or dependencies. The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #107`.

## Local results (trial-merged with current origin/main)
The only conflict was `RECOMMENDED.md`. I kept both sides in a local, unpushed commit.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `dirty_flag` | 2 passed |
| app `commands_undo` | 30 passed |
| ui `--lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 242 passed, 2 ignored |
| ui `machine` | 6 passed |
| ui `shell` | 19 passed |
| ui `egui_app` | 3 passed |
| ui `feedback` | 6 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

## Requested before merge
None.

## Notes (not blocking)
1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (about 3.5k lines) and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` (about 1.4k lines) were already far over the ~400-line guideline, and this PR adds to both. The new logic is in its own small modules, so this is only a nudge for a later split.
2. The PR says the window X path is covered by harness tests only and was not hand-tested in the real window. That is worth one hand-test, including closing a minimized window from the taskbar and Cmd+Q on macOS.
3. The ribbon-pin write from the earlier independent review (comment on this PR) now goes through the `ribbon_pins` command on main, so it should be re-checked after merge that pinning marks the document dirty.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
